subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “In the nurse's office, there was a blue chair beside the window.”?
options: The school repaired the chair and kept it by the window.
This year, a new art teacher, Ms. Park, kept the door open after school.
The school kept ten yellow raincoats in the office for students who forgot umbrellas.
A large tree stood in the middle of the school yard.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「The school repaired the chair and kept it by the window.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「This year, a new art teacher, Ms. Park, kept the door open after school.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The school kept ten yellow raincoats in the office for students who forgot umbrellas.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「A large tree stood in the middle of the school yard.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The school repaired the chair and kept it by the window.」，答案為「The school repaired the chair and kept it by the window.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「The school repaired the chair and kept it by the window.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
